chunks.head: shake off
chunks.note: shake off sth = 甩开、摆脱(睡意/困扰/追赶者)。本章指大自然抖落睡意醒来。
chunks.ex_en: I drank some coffee to shake off my sleepiness.
chunks.ex_cn: 我喝了点咖啡来赶走睡意。

chunks.head: of one's own accord
chunks.note: 无人要求或强迫，出于自己的意愿去做。

literal.note_cn: 此处指自发的意志，非“协议”

chunks.ex_en: The boy cleaned his room of his own accord.
chunks.ex_cn: 那男孩主动打扫了自己的房间。

chunks.head: by turns
chunks.note: 表示交替出现或轮换进行。本章指希望时起时落。
chunks.ex_en: The two nurses watched the patient by turns.
chunks.ex_cn: 两名护士轮流看护病人。

chunks.head: without a shadow of a doubt
chunks.note: shadow of a doubt = 一丝怀疑；整句强调完全确定、没有半点疑问。
chunks.ex_en: She is the best singer here, without a shadow of a doubt.
chunks.ex_cn: 毫无疑问，她是这里最棒的歌手。
occ: without the shadow of a doubt

chunks.head: more than once
chunks.note: 强调某事发生过多次。
chunks.ex_en: I have told you more than once to be careful.
chunks.ex_cn: 我不止一次叫你小心。

chunks.head: wide awake
chunks.note: wide 在此加强 awake，指睡意全无、非常清醒。
chunks.ex_en: After the nap I felt wide awake.
chunks.ex_cn: 睡了一觉后我感觉完全清醒了。

chunks.head: carry off
chunks.note: 本章指水流把木筏冲走。
chunks.ex_en: The strong wind carried off my hat.
chunks.ex_cn: 大风把我的帽子刮走了。

chunks.head: now and then
chunks.note: 表示不经常、间或发生。
chunks.ex_en: We still meet for coffee now and then.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们仍会偶尔一起喝咖啡。

chunks.head: fall to doing
chunks.note: fall to + 动名词，表示着手、开始(尤指投入地)做某事。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“跌落”，是习语用法

chunks.ex_en: After dinner they fell to talking about old times.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭后他们聊起了往事。

chunks.head: under one's breath
chunks.note: 声音很轻、几乎听不见地说。
chunks.ex_en: He muttered something under his breath.
chunks.ex_cn: 他低声嘀咕了几句。

chunks.head: spring to one's feet
chunks.note: 突然迅速地站起来。
chunks.ex_en: She sprang to her feet when she heard the news.
chunks.ex_cn: 一听到消息，她猛地站了起来。

chunks.head: a great many
chunks.note: 修饰可数名词复数，比 many 更强调数量之多。
chunks.ex_en: A great many people came to the fair.
chunks.ex_cn: 许许多多的人来赶集。

chunks.head: on one's account
chunks.gloss: 为了某人；因某人的缘故
chunks.note: on sb's account = 出于对某人的考虑，或因某人而引起。
chunks.ex_en: Don't stay late on my account.
chunks.ex_cn: 别为了我而熬夜。

chunks.head: best of all
chunks.note: 用于列举时引出最好的一点。
chunks.ex_en: The trip was cheap, fun, and best of all, close to home.
chunks.ex_cn: 这次旅行便宜又好玩，最棒的是离家很近。

chunks.head: after all
chunks.note: 用来说明理由或强调事实终究如此。
chunks.ex_en: Don't be too hard on him—he's just a kid, after all.
chunks.ex_cn: 别对他太严厉，毕竟他只是个孩子。

chunks.head: keep back
chunks.note: 本章指忍住、压下(念头);也可指阻止、隐瞒。
chunks.ex_en: She could not keep back her tears.
chunks.ex_cn: 她忍不住流下了眼泪。

chunks.head: get out of
chunks.note: 本章指摆脱窘境(scrape = 困境)。
chunks.ex_en: He always finds a way to get out of trouble.
chunks.ex_cn: 他总能想办法摆脱麻烦。

chunks.head: out of hearing
chunks.gloss: 在听力所及范围之外；听不到的地方
chunks.note: 距离太远而听不见；与 out of sight / out of reach 同族。
chunks.ex_en: They waited until the guard was out of hearing.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们一直等到卫兵走到听不见的地方。

chunks.head: take note of
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(take no distinct note of),故 card-only。take note of = 留心、记下。
chunks.ex_en: Please take note of the new rules.
chunks.ex_cn: 请留意新规定。

chunks.head: break into a run
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(broke into a keen run),故 card-only。break into + a run/laugh/song = 突然开始。
chunks.ex_en: As the bus arrived, he broke into a run.
chunks.ex_cn: 公交车一到，他撒腿就跑。

skipped: Finn the Red-Handed / Bill Turner (专名/人名)
becuz / 'Tain't / drownded / By jings / I reckon (方言拼写与口头禅，迁移弱)
dewdrops / catbird / tumblebug / lady-bug / sun-perch (自然名物一次性描写)
gray dawn / limpid water / majestic waste of water (一次性描述性组合)
took wing (一次性文学用法→难句层)
twilight drew on (文学性一次性)
ventured upon a roundabout feeler (一次性文学表达)
laid to rest (本章为“平息”比喻义，偏文学，控量舍去)
came back / got up / picked up / rolled up (过于基础的常见短语)
hold on (过于常见的招呼语)
plenty of / worth while (偏基础，控量舍去)
as far as ... was concerned (分离式且本章仅一次，控量舍去)
